title: RPG sandbox based on maps and locations in my real town.
author: Sky636
selftext:
I made this game completely with Claude opus 5.5 and no outside resources other than photos and maps of my city. I have promoted about 220 times or so each one causing an update in the city. I now have a website you can explore the town and tell me what you think. Full of locations, minigames, coins, powerups, police that chase you and enemies that attack you.   
If you’d like to test it and give me feedback the game is on gtavaldosta.com   
I have handoffs if anyone would like to make something like this for themselves and the game is on a multiplayer server so multiple people can log in and chat and play together at the same time
